## Experience

- AI Research Intern, Data and Model Evaluation, Appy Pie (Pixazo), Noida, June to July 2026. Built a statistical evaluation system (Elo, Bradley-Terry MLE, bootstrap confidence intervals) over 1,050 match-ups across 15 models; it caught three broken scoring signals and a leaderboard discrepancy before launch. Shipped a 22-panel React cost dashboard with an Elo-per-dollar ranking and a quality-versus-cost Pareto frontier. Audited a 73-model catalog and probed 6+ production model endpoints.

## Projects

- [CollegeBot](https://github.com/Techy-A/collegebot-rag): grounded RAG assistant with cited answers and explicit refusals. Hybrid dense and BM25 retrieval raised facts reaching the context from 77.1% to 88.6%, matching a cross-encoder reranker with no added latency. 64 offline tests.
- [Spoken grammar scoring](https://github.com/Techy-A/shl-grammar-scoring): predicts a 0 to 5 grammar score from spontaneous speech using verbatim Whisper transcripts, frozen speech encoders and an audio language model. Out-of-fold Pearson r of 0.909 on speaker-grouped folds.
- [Text-to-image evaluation arena](https://github.com/Techy-A/IMAGE-LLP-VISION): round-robin tournaments within prompt groups, five scorers, Elo and Bradley-Terry MLE rankings, runs locally.
- [Audio LLM grammar scorer](https://github.com/Techy-A/LORA_for_GPU): QLoRA fine-tuning of Voxtral-Mini-3B on an 8 GB GPU with speaker-grouped 5-fold cross-validation.
- [Self-pruning neural network](https://github.com/Techy-A/Self-Pruning-Neural-Network---Tredence-Analytics): CIFAR-10 network whose classifier head prunes itself with L1-penalised sigmoid gates.
